exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status ≤ 3 if 18 to 74 years of age or ECOG 0-2 if ≥ 75 years of age.
exclusions.threshold: ECOG <= 3 if 18-74 years; ECOG 0-2 if >= 75 years

exclusions.source_text: total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) or
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN (<= 3 x ULN in Gilbert's disease)

exclusions.source_text: Subjects with a prior or concurrent malignancy (other than MDS, MPN, MDS/MPN, or AML) whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen are eligible for this trial.
Male subjects and female subjects/women of childbearing potential (WCBP) must agree to the following:
Prior systemic cancer therapy is allowed as long as >14 days prior to study treatment start.
exclusions.threshold: > 14 days prior to study treatment start

exclusions.source_text: White blood cell count > 25x109/L prior to first dose of study treatment.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because eganelisib is an agent without known fertility and developmental toxicity studies.
